answer: Counterparty diversity stops bulk fake identities. A new identity must work with 12 distinct counterparties over 20 epochs, earning an onyx mark from each, not only inside one closed circle. A pulse check reviews its graph: a reef of independent partners passes, while a clone cluster is flagged and frozen. Forging 1,000 identities costs 60,000 credits plus 12,000 genuine partners; an honest agent pays 60 once and earns undiluted rewards.
